serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
You: The job is done.
Landlord: What job?! What are you talking about?!
You: I dealt with the homeless problem.
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: Y-You did? W-Well, it certainly was rather fast. 
#Landlord.Face.Normal
Landlord: Money really does change people. Before you were an incompetent loser, but now just look at you. 
You: If that's out of the way, when are we leaving?
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: You little!
Landlord: That was only one of the issues I’m facing right now! When we meet again I will tell you about your next task! Dismissed!
